input: Find a co-working space near my neighborhood

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing the specific neighborhood or city is essential to narrow down relevant options — without a location, no meaningful search can begin.
Budget determines which tier of co-working spaces to consider, from free/library-style options to premium memberships.
The type of workspace needed (hot desk, dedicated desk, private office) drastically changes which spaces qualify.
How often and on which days the user plans to visit affects whether a day-pass, part-time, or full-time membership makes more sense.
Whether this is for solo use or a team changes the size and layout requirements of the space.
Specific amenities (fast Wi-Fi, meeting rooms, phone booths, coffee, parking) may be non-negotiable and should filter the search.
Understanding what 'found' means — a shortlist of options, a booked trial day, or a signed membership — defines when the task is actually complete.
